author: Ryan Daws
description:
Z.ai has released GLM-5.3 with a CyberGym benchmark score of 84.5 percent, placing it ahead of rival AI models used for cybersecurity. The previous leader, Anthropic’s Mythos 5, scored 83.8 percent on the benchmark. OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol was only marginally behind Anthropic with a 83.6 percent score.
